name: Ciara Lunarlight
original_name: キアラン・ルナーライ
source:
The current head of the matrilineal Lunarlight family, a long line of exorcists based in England. She has given a specialized education in exorcism to her three duaghters, with [url=/c163967]Circe[/url] currently in training as an apprentice.

[Edited from Circe Lunarlight's in-game profile]
